proves.claim: One maintenance sweep removes a landed item's clean folder with rule item-closed, keeps a dirty one with its diff at a keep ref, and leaves a live claim's folder untouched.

cli.io-worktree-maintenance-folder-sweep.why: Without it, finished item folders pile up and fill the disk.

proves.claim: A seat idle past the takeover window and holding nothing loses its clean folder inside the grace, an agent tree on a landed item branch goes, and a seat holding a submitted item stays.

cli.io-worktree-maintenance-folder-sweep.why: Without it, dead seats and agent trees stay a day or forever and fill the disk.
